Mothership.StrengthSkillExample: Holding airlocks closed, carrying fallen comrades, climbing, pushing, jumping.
Mothership.SpeedSkillExample: Getting out of the cargo bay before the blast doors close, acting before someone (or something) else, running away.
Mothership.IntellectSkillExample: Recalling your training and experience under duress, thinking through difficult problems, inventing or fixing things.
Mothership.WhatASaveIs: You have three Saves which represent your ability to withstand different kinds of trauma. In order to avoid certain dangers, you sometimes need to roll a Save. If you roll less than your Save you succeed. Otherwise you fail, and gain 1 Stress. A roll of 90-99 is always a failure. A Critical Failure means something bad happens, and furthermore you must make a Panic Check.
Mothership.SanitySaveExample: Rationalize logical inconsistencies in the universe, make sense out of chaos, detect illusions and mimicry, cope with Stress.
Mothership.FearSaveExample: Maintain a level head while struggling with fear, loneliness, depression, and other emotional surges.
Mothership.BodySaveExample: Employ quick reflexes and resist hunger, disease, or organisms that might try and invade your insides.
Mothership.WhatGainingStressIs: You gain 1 Stress every time you fail a Stat Check or Save. Occasionally, certain locations or entities can automatically give you Stress from interacting with or witnessing them. Your Minimum Stress starts at 2, and the Maximum Stress you can have is 20. Any Stress you take over 20 instead reduces the most relevant Stat or Save by that amount.
Mothership.WhatRelievingStressIs: Occasionally, certain moments, places, or events can automatically relieve your stress. Escaping perilous situations, finding a serene location, or experiencing a touching moment with a loved one can have meaningful impacts on your mood and outlook on life. If your stress is getting close to 20, you should consider making a Rest Save - as the effects of a failed Panic Check can be devastating.
Mothership.WhatAWoundRollIs: Make a Wound Roll according to the type of Damage received.
Mothership.IfYouHaveARelevantSkill: If you have a Skill that is relevant to the task at hand, you can add the Skill’s bonus to your Stat or Save before making your roll

Mothership.ItCanBeDestroyedLikeArmor: It can be destroyed, just like armor, whenever it is dealt Damage greater than or equal to its AP. Cover typically only protects against ranged attacks, but in some situations may help block a hand-to-hand attack.
